provenance.asset_description: A 3-D mockup of the Starfinder Second Edition Murder in Metal City Deluxe Adventure Box. The Top of the box features art of a Ysoki with goggle on their head, hacks a drone in a street lit in neon lights. Behind them an android in a wide brimmed hat, holds a gun up and ready to fire at drones closing in overhead
